about: James A. Caputo is an attorney providing legal services covering Securities Litigation, Elder Law, Estate & Trust Litigation and Consumer Law.

James Caputo, who practices law in El Cajon, California, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2008 - 2011, 2020 - 2022, 2024. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at California Western School of Law. He graduated in 1984. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1985.
